detailed_description:

a technicolor 80s sword-and-sandals epic, shot on 35mm: vivid saturated colour, deep blacks and high contrast, practical sets, high-fantasy practical effects on an unlimited budget, vast torchlit stone halls with heavy drapery, brass and gold, jewelled saturated colour

ONLY the named characters are present in the shot — there are no other people, no crowd, no background figures and no extras at any point. The scene is quiet, intimate and relaxed. The characters stay where they are; nobody walks, enters, or moves toward the camera.

Only Juliana and Nekron are present, alone in the icy throne hall. Juliana stands facing Nekron in medium close-up; Nekron stands facing her. Both remain in place; nobody walks or moves toward the camera.

Where the paragraph above has both characters in frame together, the per-shot cast lines below override it: inside each shot ONLY the person named there is visible, and the other character is out of frame.

[Shot 1] The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening toward the face. On screen in this shot: exactly 1 person, alone — female, pale, long, straight, black hair, purple top with deep neckline (this is JULIANA). Nobody else is visible. <Subject 1> (S1) says: <d>[English] You have done well, my son.</d> <Subject 1> (S1) says: <d>[English] The North Village has fallen. We have won.</d>

[Shot 2] The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening toward the face. On screen in this shot: exactly 1 person, alone — male, pale grayish, long white hair, dark purple robe with black cuffs. Nobody else is visible. <Subject 1> (S2) says: <d>[English] I want to thank you, Mother.</d>

[Shot 3] The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening toward the face. The move slows and stops as the figure settles. On screen in this shot: exactly 1 person, alone — female, pale, long black hair with a headband hair, purple dress with deep neckline (this is JULIANA). Nobody else is visible. <Subject 1> (S2) says: <d>[English] The Great Plain is all that stands between ourselves and Fire Keep.</d>



overall_soundscape:

Room reverb and a low air movement through stone, distant movement echoing off hard surfaces, cloth and body movement.



non_diegetic_music:

Low sustained strings and slow woodwind pulses at a slow tempo, with sparse bell tones above; dynamics stay quiet and grow only slightly.
